<!-- FILTER CRITERIA: 1) TIME/DATE,  -->
<!-- 2) Route portion (CH46, 28&CHARL, MCC5_1) -->
<!-- TSP condition column: on/off (0/1) -->
<!-- TSP off= Anything before 02-03-2025 is TSP OFF -->
<!-- TSP on= 2025-02-03 12pm to 2025-02-10 12pm  -->
<!-- TSP ON [schedlue Cond]= 2025-02-10 12 pm to 2025-04-28 -->
<!-- TSP OFF= 2025-04-28 12pm to 2025-05-05 12pm  -->
<!-- TSP ON= 2025-05-05 12pm to 2025-05-12 at 12pm -->
<!-- TSP on [headway cond]= 2025-05-12 12pm to CURRENT/LAST DATE -->

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

wego <- read_csv("../data/Route 50 Timepoint and Headway Data, 1-1-2023 through 5-12-2025.csv")
```
```{r}
wego |> 
  filter(CALENDAR_ID == 120230101) |> 
  filter(TRIP_ID == 332422 | TRIP_ID == 332431) |> 
  select(DATE, CALENDAR_ID, TRIP_ID, ROUTE_ABBR, TIME_POINT_ABBR, TRIP_EDGE, SCHEDULED_TIME, ROUTE_DIRECTION_NAME)

```


# Combining date and scheduled time into a single column
```{r}
wego <- wego |> 
  filter((!is.na(DATE)) & (!is.na(SCHEDULED_TIME))) |> 
  mutate(
    sched_time_clean = str_extract(SCHEDULED_TIME, "\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}"),  #extract hms from SCHEDULED_TIME
    date_time_str = paste(DATE, sched_time_clean, sep = " "),  #combine columns into a single character string(date_time_str)
    datetime= ymd_hms(date_time_str) # Parse the character string into a POSIXct object
  ) |> 
  select(-c(sched_time_clean,date_time_str))
 

```

```{r}
#TSP on= 2025-02-03 12pm to 2025-02-10 12pm (unconditional)

 wego |> 
   filter(datetime>="2025-02-03 12:00:00" & datetime <= "2025-02-10 12:00:00") |>  
   filter(TIME_POINT_ABBR %in% c("CH46", "28&CHARL", "MCC5_1")) 
```

```{r}
#TSP ON [schedlue Cond]= 2025-02-10 12 pm to 2025-04-28 TSP  Priority Begins (Only buses more than 2 minutes late receive priority)

 wego |>
  
  filter((datetime>="2025-02-10 12:00:00") & (datetime <= "2025-04-28 12:00:00")) |> 
  filter(TIME_POINT_ABBR %in% c("CH46", "28&CHARL", "MCC5_1")) |> 
  filter(ADHERENCE<=-2) #filters for more than 2 mins late
  


```


```{r}
#TSP OFF= 2025-04-28 12pm to 2025-05-05 12pm

wego |>
  
  filter((datetime>="2025-04-28 12:00:00") & (datetime <= "2025-05-05 12:00:00"))



```



```{r}
#TSP ON= 2025-05-05 12pm to 2025-05-12 at 12pm


wego |>
  
  filter((datetime>="2025-05-05 12:00:00") & (datetime <= "2025-05-12 12:00:00")) |> 
  filter(TIME_POINT_ABBR %in% c("CH46", "28&CHARL", "MCC5_1"))



```


```{r}
#TSP on [headway cond]= 2025-05-12 12pm to CURRENT/LAST DATE
#TSP Headway-Conditional TSP Priority Begins (Only gapped buses with actual leading headway more than 120% of scheduled headway receive priority)

wego |> 
  filter(!is.na(HDWY_DEV), !is.na(SCHEDULED_HDWY)) |> 
  filter((HDWY_DEV>0) & (SCHEDULED_HDWY !=0))|>   #filters for gapping (more hdwy than scheduled) and filter scheduled hdwy to not zero since it gives infinity values while calculating the hdwy percentage 
  mutate(HDWY_DEV_Perc = HDWY_DEV/SCHEDULED_HDWY * 100) |> 
  filter(datetime>="2025-05-12 12:00:00") |> 
  filter(HDWY_DEV_Perc > 120)
```


```{r}
wego |> 
  mutate(
    tsp_categorical_variable = case_when(
     datetime>=as.POSIXct("2025-02-03 12:00:00") & datetime <= as.POSIXct("2025-02-10 12:00:00") & #datetime column is already of class POSIXct so we have to convert string "2025-02-03 12:00:00" to POSIXct or it would run an error (POSIXct is the standard “seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC” representation.)
     TIME_POINT_ABBR %in% c("CH46", "28&CHARL", "MCC5_1") ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0)
  ) |> 
 filter(tsp_categorical_variable==1)

```
